content.hook_text: I used to think Philippians 4:13 was about winning.
content.verse_text: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.
content.misconception: I thought this meant God would help me crush every goal, win every game, and succeed at everything I tried. I put it on my water bottle, my phone wallpaper, and said it before every test.
content.actual_meaning: Paul wrote this from prison, after learning to be content whether he had plenty or nothing. The "all things" he could do were endure hunger, need, and suffering with peace—not perform miracles on demand. The strength is for contentment, not achievement.
content.cta: What verse did you misunderstand before reading the context?
content.caption:
I had Philippians 4:13 on everything growing up. Then I actually read the chapter and realized Paul was talking about being content in prison—not scoring the winning goal.

Context changes everything.
